source_discrepancies.claim: 历史报告记录高清三宠中位占用943.5 MiB、采样峰值1958.2 MiB，约23.5fps无帧缺口；旧数据没有覆盖足够长的稳态运行。
source_discrepancies.resolution: 仅作为本轮前态线索。重新执行真实Cocoa三宠高清基线和改后测量，记录至少60秒稳态曲线、帧序、同帧画面与物理占用；不预设收益。

source_discrepancies.claim: 修改前原生三宠短测7至17fps，110秒测仍低于22fps；原有轮廓函数重复RGBA/Pillow多平面拷贝。
source_discrepancies.resolution: 独立批次用Qt原生掩码表达同一alpha覆盖规则；实现前锁定全部alpha/颜色/旋转的region像素一致性，以真实三宠检查效果，不更改显示图像或素材。

packets.goal: 同路径mtime大小素材的后台首帧解码single flight；被取消、失败或会话结束时释放认领并唤醒等待者，复用成功首帧。
packets.boundary_rationale: 只有WebMClip首帧池/锁/提交需共同变化；decode_fanout已共享bytes且无需修改。

consumer_scan.method: rg扫描RING_CAPACITY/_RingBuffer/._feed_source/_reader_feed及queue.Queue消费者；跟读publish、poll、队列put/pop调用链。
consumer_scan.result: 每个消费者通过一个Subscription环按序获得帧，reader经有界本地队列交给GUI消费。环与队列保存同一bytes对象引用。协议为(kind,data,src,reason)，帧索引从0起；取消由stop/generation控制。

upstream_contracts.semantics: data为一张RGBA源帧的不可变bytes；src_idx为0基时间线索引。每个有界环保留最新序列，容量满时丢弃最旧项。

downstream_expectations.semantics: 保持字节内容和顺序不变、有界背压和取消语义不变；不得每环、每队列、每窗口额外复制原始帧。

packets.shared_state_owner: 模块级首帧协调表拥有每素材在飞任务；WebMClip继续独占自身代次/进程/显示槽；协调任务不永久强持有图像或QObject。
invariants: No resolution/pixel/Alpha/frame-order change; Qt drawing isolation copies unchanged.
Process-wide prewarm cap remains two; one first-frame decoder per asset identity.
No GUI wait; background waits are cancellable; result published only if caller generation valid.
Leader failure/cancel releases flight, wakes all waiters; waiter cancellation cannot cancel another live consumer.
Media, user configuration, cursor facing, top flip and original branding artwork retained.

packets.goal: 固定截图侧栏布局；复用导航按钮和可中断120/140/80ms反馈；语义图标及动作库选择/请求/排队/当前播放状态；系统减少动态效果；右侧可读性。
packets.boundary_rationale: 侧栏图标绘制、一级/二级按钮状态动画和展开布局由同一导航装配协调；设置行组件和持久设置模型不属于本包。

consumer_scan.method: rg扫描SidebarNavigationButton、expand_domain_navigation、vector_widget_icon和QVariantAnimation的全部调用、测试和截图入口。
consumer_scan.result: 设置域和子页面共用SidebarNavigationButton；一级图标走语义矢量provider，二级项缩进显示；ModernSettingsDialog拥有域/页选择，SettingsTabContainer拥有subtask状态。暂无新增持久设置需求。

upstream_contracts.semantics: Preserve currently available domain order, actual page indices and per-setting owner (pure build exposes seven domains as screenshot).

downstream_expectations.consumer: Qt sidebar and native visual acceptance
downstream_expectations.semantics: 保持键盘焦点、checked状态、几何和accessible name/路由；动画只说明悬停/选择状态并可中断。

packets.shared_state_owner: ModernSettingsDialog owns current domain, SettingsTabContainer owns subtask; buttons own transient hover/selection/press; ActionLibrary owns visible selection/pending request/queued state; command client owns IPC.
invariants: Screenshot sidebar positions, width, spacing, hierarchy/order/brand/footer retained.
Only settings and action library presentation changes; no persisted preferences or IPC schema changes.
Icons use new settings-only keys where replacing shared provider semantics would change menus.
Reuse existing Qt widgets; reduced-motion query via native ctypes without PyObjC dependency; hidden/destroyed animations stopped.
Action selection/scroll retained if visible; duplicate requests suppressed; actual current state follows watch_actions.
